rationale: C12 is expressly invoked by the child and supplies the child’s central administrative framework. C12 section 3 authorizes the Federal Civil Defense Administrator to identify and arrange for Federal personnel useful in emergencies and to coordinate those arrangements with State and local civil-defense plans. The child adapts that machinery to pre-emergency training: the Administrator recommends volunteered and selected Federal personnel, department heads authorize their participation, and the order specifies employment-status, time, documentation, compensation, and travel conditions. C06 and C21 share civil-defense coordination machinery but do not match the child as directly or concretely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In arranging for the use of personnel of Federal departments and agencies for civil-defense purposes in time of emergency and for their coordination with State and local civil-defense plans in consonance with the provisions of section 3 of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of April 17, 1952
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Federal Civil Defense Administrator shall assist the departments and agencies by indicating the types of personnel, materials, facilities, and services considered useful for civil-defense purposes in time of emergency; arrange for the use of such personnel, materials, facilities, and services ...; and coordinate such arrangements with national, State, and local civil-defense plans.
shared_material.explanation: The child expressly identifies C12 section 3 and closely reproduces its distinctive sequence: identify useful Federal personnel, arrange their use, and coordinate the arrangements with State and local plans.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Federal Civil Defense Administrator, after consultation with the head of a department or agency, may recommend that the services of such personnel ... be made available
shared_material.parent_excerpt: each Federal department and agency shall, in consultation with the Federal Civil Defense Administration, prepare plans for providing its personnel ... during the existence of a civil-defense emergency
shared_material.explanation: Both use consultation between the Administrator and individual agencies as the mechanism for making Federal personnel available for civil-defense functions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: may from year to year authorize ... personnel ... to participate in pre-emergency training programs and test exercises in cooperation with any State or political sub-division thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: coordinate such arrangements with national, State, and local civil-defense plans
shared_material.explanation: The child extends C12’s emergency personnel-coordination framework into pre-emergency State and local training and adds detailed implementing conditions.
